title: Fruit Link Match
description: Connect juicy pairs of strawberries, lemons, and kiwis using paths with at most two turns—race the clock to clear bright orchard boards.
controls: Tap two matching fruit tiles that can connect with a clear path of up to three straight segments.

zh-CN.title: 水果连连看
zh-CN.description: 国民经典益智水果连连看：眼疾手快连接两个相同水果且拐弯不超过两次即可闪电消除，清爽脆甜越玩越上头！
zh-CN.controls: 依次点击两张相同水果牌，只要连线折弯不超过两次即可闪电消除，清空棋盘过关。
